title: Cykoria
description: cykoria.pl Cykoria S.A. is a Polish food ingredients manufacturer founded in 1996 in Wąpielsk, specializing in instant chicory, dietary fibers including inulin and oligofructose, vegetable powders and custom food blends. With approximately 300 to 400 employees and revenue estimated at 20 to 40 million euro, it exports to over 40 countries across Europe, Asia, the US, Africa and the Middle East. The company processes chicory roots through its full production cycle from harvesting to extraction and spray drying at its facilities in Wąpielsk and Rypin. It holds ISO 22000, HACCP, BRC, IFS, Halal, Kosher and Organic certifications. Listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange NewConnect market, it is one of the largest chicory processors in Europe. Its products serve food and beverage, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, bakery and animal feed industries globally.
